title: Shrimp Fried This Rice Heavy Cotton T-Shirt, Funny Food Pun Tee, Foodie Gift
description:
You’re telling me shrimp fried this rice?

This funny shrimp fried rice shirt combines a mouthwatering photographic bowl of fried rice with a wonderfully ridiculous food pun. It makes a fun gift for foodies, shrimp lovers, home cooks, chefs, restaurant workers, dad-joke collectors, and anyone who always orders the fried rice.

Printed on a Gildan 5000 Heavy Cotton T-shirt, this tee has a comfortable classic fit and durable midweight feel that works well throughout the year.

PRODUCT FEATURES

• Gildan 5000 Heavy Cotton T-shirt
• Classic unisex fit
• Medium-weight 180 g/m² fabric
• Solid colors are 100% cotton
• Tubular construction with no side seams
• Ribbed knit collar helps retain its shape
• Shoulder tape provides additional stability
• Tear-away label for added comfort
• Detailed direct-to-garment printed design
• OEKO-TEX® certified
• Made using ethically sourced US cotton

FIT AND SIZING

This is a classic-fit shirt, not an oversized or boxy-fit tee. Please review the size chart before ordering. For a roomier, relaxed appearance, consider sizing up one size.

CARE INSTRUCTIONS

• Machine wash cold, maximum 30°C or 90°F
• Tumble dry on low heat
• Use non-chlorine bleach only when needed
• Do not iron
• Do not dry clean

PRODUCTION

This original design is printed especially for you after your order is placed. Because each shirt is made to order, slight variations in color and print placement may occur between the product shown on screen and the finished garment.

Designed by HomeFromWorking and professionally printed and shipped by a production partner.

Artwork for this design was created with the assistance of an AI image-generation tool and arranged into the finished shirt design by HomeFromWorking.
